CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  August 9, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  Ankit Udani
  Staff Present:  Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA
All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - July 26, 2022

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the Minutes.

ITEM 2: 715 North Olive Street
This application is for exterior alteration to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

Item 2 was pulled by the public - Jennifer Ng

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve Item 1 of the consent calendar.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 715 North Olive Street
This application is for exterior alteration to an existing single-family residence.

  1
 RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant and owner were present.

Staff comments were made.

Jennifer Ng stated that she was excited to see the property developed. She did say that the door was
too narrow for a Craftsman home.

Daninger stated that the water heater is exposed to the street and questioned the enclosure. (Shown
on the west elevation).

The contractor Erick Toss stated that the enclosure would match the building color.

Tsai questioned if there was a gate proposed to enclose the side yard.

The contractor stated that there will be a fence that will be done in the style of the existing fence.

Tsai stated that the fence could be subject to staff review.

Hernandez questioned if the owner preferred a wider front door. Daniel Medrano stated that the
existing door is 36” wide but he is willing to widen the door to 40”. He also stated that he would
comply with the statements given regarding the water heater and fence. Hernandez concurred with
the discussion.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the project with the following conditions: 1) water heater enclosure
  shall match the existing house color; 2) any fencing shall be subject to full documentation
  and DRB staff review; 3) the entry door shall be widened to 40’ and in a craftsman style.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

ITEM 3: 1200 West Valley Blvd.
This application is for exterior alterations and signage for an existing commercial building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The drawings shall be updated to reflect a code-compliant design for the secondary line of copy;
and 2. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present. Staff comments were made.

  2
 Daninger had no comments.

Tsai had no comments.

Hernandez confirmed that there was little difference between the proposed signage and the existing
building. She further stated that the red building color could be modified to lessen the impact of the
color on the massing of the building.

The applicant stated that it is part of the national branding. This is their preferred color scheme.

Hernandez continued that there are architectural elements that could be incorporated into the color
blocking to improve the building scale.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The drawings shall
  be updated to reflect a code-compliant design for the secondary line of copy; and 2. All
  revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance. The
  second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

ITEM 4: 129 Linda Vista Avenue
This application is for a new fence for an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The drawings shall be updated to include all elevations of the new fence; and 2. All revised drawings
shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present.

Daninger stated that he concurred with staff. The angles of the new fence should match the angles
of the existing fence.

Tsai concurred. The drawing is rough and doesn’t show a concrete cap or the number of courses is
in question.

Hernandez concurred that the drawings need to be accurate.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The drawings shall
  be updated to be accurate and include all elevations of the new fence; and 2. All revised
  drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.
 •  The second was by Daninger.

  3
   •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

ITEM 5: 2015 Chestnut Street
This application is for exterior alteration for an existing commercial building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
John Lundstrom shared his screen with renderings. The first image illustrated the originally
proposed design which sparked staff comments. The redesigned image introduced a blue frame at
the one story mass of the building and added a layering of screens to reduce the building mass
through color and material. The screen face at the upper level is a smooth finish as opposed to the
existing corrugated metal screen.

Jennifer Ng concurred with staff and stated that the building is still top heavy but a definite
improvement.

Steve De Sena gave context to the reasoning behind the driving forces that necessitated this new
mechanical equipment.

Daninger liked the new design and appreciated the context given.

Tsai questioned if there could be a greater setback on the upper screen. Especially at the east
elevation.

Hernandez questioned the equipment. She confirmed that it is new equipment. She also questioned
if there would be more equipment in the future. The applicant stated that there would be no
additional equipment.

The applicant added that they made a commitment to stay in Alhambra.

Abe stated that the DRB staff was in support of this design direction and that he would work with
the applicant

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the new design direction with the condition that the applicant
  work with staff to finalize design details regarding the extent and setback of the screening
  panels.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

  4
 ITEM 6: 1600 Cabrillo Avenue
This application is for a one-story addition and a porch to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval.

ACTION MINUTES:
Jennifer Ng stated that there was vast improvement from the original submittal. She questioned the
sidelight at the front entry.

Tsai stated that he had no comments.

Daninger stated that he liked the revised proposal.

Hernandez stated that she was accepting of the design.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the condition that the designer shall work with
  DRB staff on the entry door configuration.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

ITEM 7: 314 South 8th Street
This application is for a new one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance to allow for resolution of
fundamental stylistic issues and a redesign of the roof plan.

ACTION MINUTES:
Jennifer Ng stated that she agreed with the staff comments. She stated that the windows facing the
front of the street should be similar to the existing house. Bert Ng was also confused by the materials
submitted and suggested craftsman consistent materials.

The designer stated that she could add window trim. Tsai stated that the existing house has window
trim and the proposed drawings are inconsistent. There is a lot of information missing or inconsistent
on the drawings. Daninger concurred and stated that the windows should be consistent.

Hernandez stated that if necessary they could remodel the entire house in a different style.

The designer explained some of the drawing inconsistencies.

Hernandez stated that there were multiple issues that need resolution.

  5
 MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to continue the application to allow redesign.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:52 P.M. to the next meeting on
August 23, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:52
 •  Seconded by Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Hernandez, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Udani

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 23rd day of August, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
